# 3.0 - Roleplay Expectations [color=#e6e6e6]Expectations and policies centered around roleplay.[/color]
- [textlink="3.1 — Do not intentionally prepare for unrealistic situations in order to gain an advantage." link="Rule3.1"] - [textlink="3.2 — Do not excessively crowd RP situations or events." link="Rule3.2"] - [textlink="3.3 — Avoid abandoning your job without a sufficient reason." link="Rule3.3"] - [textlink="3.4 — Follow the new life rule." link="Rule3.4"] - [textlink="3.5 — Full continuity of your character and the events that happen to them is recommended, but not required." link="Rule3.5"] - [textlink="3.6 — Stay within your job or role. Retain reasonable knowledge, abilities, and skills according to your job and your characters' backstories." link="Rule3.6"] - [textlink="3.7 — Competence is expected within command and security." link="Rule3.7"] - [textlink="3.8 — Silicons should follow their laws to the best of their ability." link="Rule3.8"]
